# Visual & PDF Redesign Checklist: Página de Inicio, Rediseño Visual, Clientes y Estados de Presupuesto

**Purpose**: Validar la calidad (completitud, claridad, consistencia y medibilidad) de los requisitos de rediseño visual — tipografía, paleta, espaciado, jerarquía y estados de presupuesto — compartidos entre la aplicación web y el PDF, antes de pasar a `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-07-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/identidad-visual.md](../contracts/identidad-visual.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Foco: rediseño visual y PDF. Profundidad: estándar.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for how presupuesto states are distinguished by means other than color alone (text label, icon), for users with color vision deficiency? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are loading-state or error-state requirements defined for the activity summary on the home page when the presupuestos data cannot be retrieved? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does the spec explicitly state whether a presupuesto's estado is included in, or excluded from, the PDF's content? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the zero-content state of the visual redesign (e.g., an empty Clientes list or an Inicio summary with all counts at zero) beyond "no error"? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are minimum color-contrast requirements specified for text, badges and totals to support the "profesional y sobria" goal? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "paleta de colores limitada" (FR-007) quantified with a maximum number of colors, or left fully to design discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "espaciado uniforme" (FR-008) quantified with a spacing scale or specific values, or left fully to design discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "tipografía consistente" (FR-006) defined beyond "un único lugar" — e.g., does it specify a minimum set of type sizes/weights to distinguish titles from body text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "jerarquía visual clara" (FR-009) defined with any measurable property (size ratio, weight, contrast), or is it left as a subjective judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "misma identidad visual" between la web y el PDF (FR-014) defined with objective criteria (e.g., mismos valores de color y familia tipográfica), or does it rely purely on comparación visual subjetiva? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Does the requirement for a single source of truth for color/typography (FR-007, FR-006) explicitly account for the PDF needing its own, separately maintained definition (per FR-014 and research.md punto 6), or could "un único lugar" be read as contradicting that? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007 vs §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the five estado colors (Borrador/Enviado/Aceptado/Rechazado/Caducado) required to be visually consistent across all three surfaces where they appear (listado, detalle, resumen de inicio)? Is this stated once or does each surface need its own restated requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are touch-target size expectations for new interactive elements (acción rápida de estado en el listado, selector de cliente guardado) required to match the sizing already implied for existing controls, or left unspecified? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the mobile-first requirements for new screens (Inicio, Clientes) stated as equivalent in rigor to the mobile-first requirement for existing screens, or could they be read as a lighter-weight expectation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Can SC-008 ("reconoce a simple vista que comparten la misma tipografía y paleta de colores") be objectively verified by someone other than the person who built it, or does it depend on subjective recognition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can SC-007 ("sin scroll horizontal ni elementos cortados") be verified without specifying a minimum target viewport width? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is there a measurable acceptance criterion for "estados visuales distinguibles" beyond User Story 3's Acceptance Scenario 3 (which only asserts distinguishability qualitatively)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are acceptance criteria defined for how quickly/where a color-blind user should be able to tell two adjacent states apart, or is this left entirely to CHK001's gap? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are visual requirements defined for the presupuesto detail view when the freelancer has not configured a perfil (existing spec 001 empty state) under the new visual hierarchy rules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for how the estado badge should render in a listado row while a state change is in progress (optimistic update vs. wait-for-response)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for the visual treatment of a presupuesto that has zero líneas (no total to highlight) under the new hierarchy rules (FR-009)? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for how the PDF should render printed in black & white (i.e., do status-related colors, if shown, remain distinguishable without color)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the visual/navigational behavior when a freelancer resizes the browser window across the mobile-first breakpoint while mid-navigation? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for how the common navigation should behave if the list of sections doesn't fit on the narrowest supported screen width? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for what happens visually when a client's nombre/razón social is unusually long in a badge/list context (truncation, wrap)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are there any stated constraints on PDF file size or rendering time introduced by the visual redesign (e.g., new fonts, background colors)? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard focus visibility, screen reader labeling for estado badges) specified anywhere in the spec, or entirely absent? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the assumption that "the frontend and backend cannot share a build-time token source" (research.md punto 6) validated against the actual deployment setup, or just asserted? [Assumption, research.md §6]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is it documented who is responsible for keeping `generarPdf.js`'s color constants manually synchronized with `base.css`, and what happens if they drift? [Gap, Dependency]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK030 - Is the exact hex/RGB value for each of the five estado colors specified anywhere, or fully deferred to implementation (contracts/identidad-visual.md)? Is that deferral an intentional decision or an open gap? [Ambiguity, Contract §identidad-visual.md]
- [ ] CHK031 - Does "sobria" (FR title/User Story 3) have any shared understanding documented (e.g., reference examples, rejected alternatives), or is it purely a subjective adjective left to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3]
